title.narrative: PIMS-10103 Building capacity to advance National Adaptation Plan Process in Yemen (GCF NAP)

description.narrative: The project goal is to make Yemen more resilient to the impacts of climate change through robust national and sub-national adaptation planning, improved institutional capacity, and the implementation of gender-responsive, inclusive, and climate-resilient development policies, while fostering synergies with peacebuilding efforts by promoting social cohesion, engaging conflict-affected communities, and ensuring local ownership in adaptation measures. The objective of this GCF readiness grant is to establish the NAP process in Yemen and strengthen the institutional coordination, policy, technical and financial framework capacities in key sectors with conflict sensitive approaches for adaptation planning.

title.narrative: Developing and implementing the National Adaptation Plan (NAP) Process in Yemen

condition.narrative: Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).

The Implementing Partner shall ensure that all of its obligations set forth under the section entitled “Legal Context and/or Risk Management Standard Clauses” are passed on to each responsible party, subcontractor and sub-recipient and that all the clauses under this section entitled “Risk Management” are included, mutatis mutandis, in all sub-contracts or sub-agreements entered into further to the Project Document
